title: 第13章 四声算绝世天才十声算什么第14章 北灵院长登场
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
广场上，有数百名学员正在修炼。
见到有人靠近测试钟，他们并没有在意。
古钟放在广场，就是为了测试学员们的天赋。
而刚进来的新学员，都会进行一次测试。
其余时间，几乎没有人会去接触测试钟。
现在已经过了招收学员的时间，众人只把楚云当成一个外来参观的好奇者。
楚云一步步朝着古钟走去。
等来到古钟前，他也没有发现古钟有什么奇特之处。
倒是上面勾画的符文，让楚云产生了一丝好奇。
当下他伸手轻轻抚摸。
就在这时，一股奇异的能量传来，让楚云的灵魂一震。
感受到这股能量，楚云连忙松开手。
此时他已经猜出一定是这股能量，决定了武者的天赋。
当下不再犹豫，抬起手臂，一拳击打在古钟上。
咚！
一道浑厚的钟声瞬间响起。
听到钟声响起，在场修炼的学员全部停了下来。
“这人是谁，好像不是我们学院的学员，居然能够敲响测试钟，看来天赋不错。”
马脸老者本来想看楚云的笑话。
但是见到楚云居然能够敲响测试钟后，他脸上的笑容瞬间凝固。

“他不是废物？”
叶灵儿道：“徒儿都说他不是废物了，但师父你就是不信。”
马脸老者冷声道：“就算不是废物，修为也高不到哪里去。”
叶灵儿一脸疑惑，道：“师傅难道看不出他的修为？”
马脸老者自然看不出楚云的修为。
但他不会认为是楚云的修为比他高。
当下道：“他应该是修炼了某种隐藏修为的功法，所以为师看不出他的修为。”
与此同时。
北灵学院中心处，一处阁楼房间中。
一名鹤发童颜的白袍老者，正在和一名青袍老者下棋。
就在白袍老者手中的棋子，快要落在棋盘上时。
咚！
一道浑厚的钟声突然响起。
白袍老者手中的动作瞬间停止。
只见他转头看向窗外，一脸疑惑道：“怎么回事，还没到招收学员的时间，是谁敲响测试钟？”
测试钟，只有招收学员的时候才会使用。
而凡是进入北灵学院的学员，几乎都去测试过。
所以后面几乎不会有人再去碰。
现在测试钟突然响起，让他很是疑惑。
青袍老者笑道：“应该是某些势力的弟子，想要加入我们北灵学院，所以强行用修为敲响测试钟，不必在意。”

这种情况在北灵学院出现过几次，所以两人也没有在意。
正要继续下棋。
content_en:
In the square, there are hundreds of students practicing.
When they saw someone approaching the test clock, they didn't pay attention.
The ancient clock was placed in the square to test the talents of the students.
New students who have just come in will take a test.
The rest of the time, almost no one touches the test clock.
Now that the time for recruiting students has passed, everyone only regards Chu Yun as a curious visitor.
Chu Yun walked towards the ancient bell step by step.
When he came to the ancient clock, he didn't find anything strange about the ancient clock.
It was the runes outlined on it that made Chu Yun a little curious.
Now he stretched out his hand and touched it gently.
At this moment, a strange energy came, shocking Chu Yun's soul.
Feeling this energy, Chu Yun quickly let go of his hand.
At this time, he had already guessed that it must be this energy that determines a warrior's talent.
Without hesitation, he raised his arm and punched the ancient clock.
Boom!
A loud bell sounded instantly.
When they heard the bell ringing, all the practitioners present stopped.
"Who is this person? He doesn't seem to be a student of our academy. He can actually ring the test bell. He seems to have good talent."
The horse-faced old man originally wanted to see Chu Yun's joke.
But after seeing that Chu Yun was able to ring the test bell, the smile on his face instantly froze.
"Isn't he a loser?"
Ye Ling'er said: "My disciples all say that he is no longer useless, but master, you just don't believe it."
The horse-faced old man said coldly: "Even if he is not a waste, his cultivation level is not much higher."
Ye Ling'er looked puzzled and said, "Master, can't you see his cultivation level?"
Naturally, the horse-faced old man couldn't tell Chu Yun's cultivation level.
But he would not think that Chu Yun's cultivation level was higher than his.
He immediately said: "He should have practiced some kind of skill that hides his cultivation, so the teacher cannot see his cultivation."
At the same time.
In the center of Beiling College, in an attic room.
An old man in white robes with gray hair and a childlike face was playing chess with an old man in green robes.
Just when the chess piece in the white-robed old man's hand was about to land on the chessboard.
Boom!
A loud bell suddenly rang.
The movements in the hands of the old man in white robes stopped instantly.
He turned to look out the window and said with a puzzled look on his face: "What's going on? It's not time to recruit students yet, who is ringing the test bell?"
The test clock is only used when recruiting students.
Almost all students who enter Beiling College have taken the test.
So almost no one will touch it again.
Now the test bell suddenly rang, which made him very confused.
The old man in green robe smiled and said: "It should be the disciples of some forces who want to join our Beiling Academy, so they forcefully use their cultivation to ring the test bell. Don't worry about it."
This situation had happened several times in Beiling College, so the two of them didn't pay attention.
Just about to continue playing chess.
